title: Understanding Hair Porosity
summary: The float test, and what low, medium and high porosity mean for the products you choose.
body:
Knowing your hair porosity is the key to choosing the right products. It decides how well your hair absorbs and holds on to moisture.

## The float test

Drop a clean strand of shed hair into a glass of water. If it sinks quickly, you have high porosity. If it floats, low porosity. If it hangs in the middle, medium.

## Low porosity tips

Use gentle heat when conditioning to open the cuticle, and skip heavy oils that only sit on top of the strand.
